Our Story

About Us

A student-run home bakery built on one simple rule: no shortcuts, ever.

The People Behind the Kneads

Made with love, not mixes

Katered Kneads started because we kept asking: why does so much "homemade" food taste like it came from a bag? We decided to do something about it.

Founded by siblings Ellyse and Jake — one obsessed with the kitchen, one with making it all run — every drop is a reflection of the care that only comes from people who genuinely love what they make.

We serve UC Berkeley and UC Davis through limited biweekly preorders. We keep quantities deliberately small so every single bake gets the attention it deserves. When your order arrives, it was made for you — not sitting on a shelf.

"We started Katered Kneads because we believe everyone deserves a truly great cookie — made by hand, with real ingredients, and absolutely no shortcuts."

— Ellyse & Jake, co-founders

100% Scratch No mixes, no pre-made dough. Every knead starts from raw ingredients.
Made to Order We only bake what's been preordered — no waste, maximum freshness.
Deliberately Limited Small batches so every single bake gets the care it deserves.

Don't Take Our Word for It

What our customers say

"The mochi brownies are unlike anything I've ever had. I set an alarm for the drops now — absolutely worth it."

— UC Berkeley student

"You can actually taste the difference when something is made from scratch. These cookies are the real deal."

— UC Davis customer

"I ordered on a whim and now I've been on the SMS list for months. Cannot miss a drop."

— recurring customer

Get in Touch

Contact Us

Email

Instagram

Campuses

UC Berkeley & UC Davis

Common Questions

Frequently Asked

Preorders open once every two weeks. When orders open, you'll have a limited window to visit our order page and select your items. We bake exactly what's been ordered, so quantities are limited. Join our SMS list on the order page to be notified the moment a drop opens.
We offer pickup at UC Berkeley and UC Davis. When you place an order, you'll select your campus. The exact pickup spot and time are confirmed with each drop.
We typically offer 3–4 different cookies or baked goods per drop. The menu is announced when preorders open — follow us on Instagram or join the SMS list to see what's dropping next.
Yes. Most of our bakes contain gluten (wheat flour), dairy (butter, milk, cream), and eggs. Everything is made in a home kitchen that also handles tree nuts, sesame, and other common allergens. Please get in touch before ordering if you have a severe allergy.
Because we bake in small, planned batches, modifications and cancellations can only be accepted up to 48 hours before pickup. After that window we're unable to offer changes or refunds. For urgent issues, reach out via Instagram DM or email and we'll do our best to help.

How It Works

Preorders open every two weeks. Here's how to never miss a drop.

Check the Drop
